title: Fold letter case when matching paths on win32 and darwin; never canonicalise with realpath
body: Compare and match repository paths with letter case folded on win32 and darwin (relativize in src/hooks/events.cjs lowercases both sides; FOLD_CASE in src/engine/clause.cjs compiles globs with the i flag on those platforms) and never canonicalise a hook's cwd or file path with realpath: it also resolves junctions and symlinks (macOS /tmp is /private/tmp), so a project reached through a link stops relativizing to the repository root and nothing matches. Linux keeps case apart on purpose. Why: comparing resolve() strings once split one project into two data directories by case; a first fix used realpathSync.native and broke linked projects, so case folding replaced it (2026-10-12).
not_derivable: The code folds case; that realpath was tried and rejected, and why, is only in a plan ledger kept outside git.

evidence.summary: relativize folds case on both sides.
